reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows Hf–Zr alloy formation on a different substrate (HEA) under sintering, but does not address Cr–Zr interdiffusion, Cr coating systems, or performance in water/steam environments. The key premises about diffusion-barrier efficacy, corrosion resistance, and high-temperature steam performance are unsupported by the provided evidence.
premises: Hf interlayer forms a Hf–Zr alloy transition layer with the Zr substrate
The Hf–Zr transition layer acts as a diffusion barrier against Cr–Zr interdiffusion
The barrier limits Zr migration into the Cr coating and preserves coating integrity
The Hf interlayer maintains corrosion resistance under normal subcritical-water conditions (~300°C)
